entries.en: For we Amalj'aa, Zanr'ak is more than merely dust and rock─it is sacred ground. The preservation of this holy land is our duty and our privilege.
entries.fr: Une terre sacrée, Zanr'ak est pour nous Amalj'aa. La protéger, notre devoir est. Des dégâts, les êtres doués de la parole provoquent. Mais l'endommager, la faune peut aussi.
entries.ja:
ここザンラク一帯は、我らアマルジャ族の聖地。
その保全は、我らの当然の務め。

entries.en: One of the greatest threats to its delicate balance are the voracious bronze tortoises. These insatiable creatures wander as their appetite leads them, feeding without surcease. Slaughtering them brings little respite, for they multiply at a seemingly unnatural pace.
